purpose: The REDUM TEAM-LENS arm of the unified team-copilot differential. Each mutant is a self-contained fixture (a teammate work-state `stream` + the `corrupted` team-candidate partition a BUGGY lens would emit, breaking ONE invariant). bin/falsify team-copilot runs the gate against golden (expect PASS — the REAL redum team lens equals the independent reference) then every mutant (expect REJECT — the gate recomputes the CORRECT partition from the stream via the independent reference and diffs it against `corrupted`). Score = mutants rejected / total, conditioned on golden passing; a P0 gate requires 1.0.

mutants.name: cross-team-read
mutants.defect: a DIFFERENT team's surface leaks into the roster — team isolation broken

mutants.name: content-leak
mutants.defect: a teammate's active_goal prose leaks into a candidate field instead of the scrubbed handle

mutants.name: stale-claim-not-reaped
mutants.defect: a reaped teammate (checkpoint survives, claim dropped) is shown as in-flight instead of adoptable — recovery broken

mutants.name: inflight-misclass
mutants.defect: a teammate actively building is shown as adoptable-dropped — prevention broken

mutants.name: dropped-teammate
mutants.defect: a whole teammate row is dropped from the roster — recoverable work silently vanishes
